acao: The armored squid escapes with a jet stroke, staying in the same spot: first it gathers impulse, pulling its tentacles in and coiling them tight against its body; then it kicks them out in one powerful push; then the tentacles stretch out straight and close together behind it in a long streamlined trail, and it holds that stretched pose. It keeps the same size (it does not shrink), the same diagonal orientation and the same dark colors.
